data.text: I’m in: I commit to catching 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided we all keep to the agreed catches, including Luke’s zero. That completes the $60,000 without any extra fishing. I also commit to 6 tons next month, then 10 once the lake returns to 100. Luke, please confirm your zero catch and the recovery limits so we leave with everyone on the same page.
